for a in d.get('audit',{}).get('advisories',{}).values(): print('ADVISORY', json.dumps({'module_name':a.get('module_name'),'severity':a.get('severity'),'patched_versions':a.get('patched_versions'),'recommendation':a.get('recommendation')}, sort_keys=True))
